text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Server

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  deployments: write

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run Tests
        run: cargo test

      - name: Deploy to Server
        run: |
          echo "Deploying application..."
          # Placeholder for actual deployment logic (e.g., SSH, Docker push, etc.)
          # Example:
          # ssh user@server "cd /app && git pull && cargo build --release && systemctl restart app"
```
